Figure caption: Svg3 promoted DC co-stimulation and antigen presentation for protein and mRNA vaccines(A and B) Flow cytometry histograms and quantified mean fluorescence intensity (MFI) showed that Svg3 elevated the expression of costimulatory factors on DC2.4 cells. The expression levels of costimulatory factors CD80, CD86, and CD40 were measured by flow cytometry. Svg3 was transfected using Lipofectamine 2000; vehicle: blank Lipofectamine 2000. (C) Svg3 promoted antigen (SIINFEKL) presentation of OVA protein antigen on DC2.4 cells. CpG adjuvant was used as a benchmark adjuvant. SIINFEKL presentation on DCs was measured by H-2Kb/SIINFEKL antibody staining and flow cytometric analysis. (D) RNA-seq analysis of murine BMDMs. (E) Svg3 promoted the ability of OVA to activate SIINFEKL-specific B3Z reporter CD8+ T cells in vitro. (F) Svg3 promoted the antigen presentation of mRNA-OVA vaccine on DC2.4 cells. mRNA-OVA, alone or together with Svg3, was loaded in SM-102 LNPs. DC2.4 cells were treated with the resulting LNPs for 24 h, followed by measuring H-2Kb/SIINFEKL levels on cells by antibody staining and flow cytometric analysis as earlier. Data: mean ± SD. ns, not significant; p > 0.05; ∗p < 0.05; ∗∗p < 0.01; ∗∗∗p < 0.001. p value was determined by Student’s t test.

Figure caption: LNPs codelivered Svg3 with peptide or mRNA vaccines to draining lymph nodes and intranodal APCs(A) DLS histograms showing the hydrodynamic size distributions of LNPs coloaded with Svg3 with E7 peptide or mRNA. (B) Cryo-EM images of LNPs coloaded with the corresponding vaccines. (C) Left: inguinal lymph node imaging 16 h after s.c. injection of LNP-loaded Cy3-labeled Svg3 and FITC-labeled SIINFEKL peptide at the tail base of C57BL/6 mice. Right: quantified flow cytometric analysis showing the fractions of Cy3-Svg3+ SIINFEK(FITC)L+ macrophages and DCs among total live CD45+ cells from inguinal lymph nodes, indicating that LNPs promoted the codelivery of Svg3 and SIINFEKL to intranodal APCs. (D) Left: inguinal lymph node imaging of live BALB/c mice 6 h after s.c. injection of LNP-loaded mRNA-fLuc, alone or together with Svg3. Right: quantified bioluminescence signal intensities in draining inguinal lymph nodes 6 h after s.c. injection. Data: mean ± SD. ns, not significant; p > 0.05; ∗p < 0.05; ∗∗p < 0.01; ∗∗∗p < 0.001. p value was determined by Student’s t test.

Figure caption: Svg3 adjuvant potentiated antigen-specific CD8+ T cell responses for protein, peptide, and mRNA vaccines in mice(A) Study timeline of PBMC T cell response. (B–D) Svg3 promoted the antigen-specific T cell responses for OVA protein (B), SIINFEKL peptide (C), and E7 peptide (D). At the tail base, C57BL/6 mice were s.c. injected with admixed OVA and Svg3 or SM-102 LNPs coloaded with adjuvants and peptides. cGAMP, an STING agonist, was used as a benchmark adjuvant. PBMC SIINFEKL-specific PBMC CD8+ T cells were analyzed by H-2Kb-SIINFEKL tetramer staining on day 35 after vaccination. (E) Study timeline of PBMC T cell responses for LNPs coloaded with Svg3 and mRNA-OVA vaccine. (F) Representative flow cytometry gating of SIINFEKL-specific PBMC CD8+ T cells on day 21. (G) Svg3 increased the fractions of SIINFEKL-specific PBMC CD8+ T cells when codelivered with mRNA-OVA by LNPs. PBMC SIINFEKL-specific CD8+ T cells were analyzed by tetramer staining on day 21. (H) PD-1 expression level on PBMC CD8+ T cells on day 21 from the aforementioned mice. (I) The fractions of SIINFEKL-specific PBMC CD8+ T cells analyzed on day 35. (J) Fractions of PBMC central memory CD8+ T cells, effector memory CD8+ T cells, naive T cells, and other cells on day 35. Data: mean ± SEM. ns, not significant;’ p > 0.05; ∗p < 0.05; ∗∗p < 0.01; ∗∗∗p < 0.001; ∗∗∗∗p < 0.0001. p value was determined by Student’s t test.

Figure caption: Svg3 enhanced the tumor therapeutic efficacy of hexavalent neoantigen-encoding mRNA vaccines(A) Treatment timeline for MC38 tumor therapy. (B) MC38 tumor sizes on day 24. (C–F) MC38 TME analysis on day 24 after the indicated treatments. (C) Svg3 promoted the tumor infiltration of MC38 neoantigen-specific T cells, as shown for neoantigen Adpgk as a representative. The fractions of Adpgk-specific CD8+ T cells in tumors were measured by Adpgk/H-2Db tetramer staining. (D) Svg3 enhanced the ability of neoantigen mRNA vaccines to reduce Treg abundance in tumors. (E and F) MC38 tumor-infiltrated immune cell analysis. Data: mean ± SEM. ns, not significant; p > 0.05; ∗p < 0.05; ∗∗p < 0.01; ∗∗∗p < 0.001. p value was determined by Student’s t test.

Figure caption: LNP codelivery of Svg3 and HPV-16 E7 peptide or bivalent E6-E7-encoding mRNA promoted TC-1 tumor immunotherapy in combination with anti-PD1(A) TC-1 tumor treatment timeline using E7 peptide in combination with anti-PD-1. (B) TC-1 tumor growth curves after the indicated treatments. (C) Individual TC-1 tumor growth curves. (D) TC-1 tumor treatment timeline using mRNA-E6-E7 in combination with anti-PD-1. (E) Tumor growth curves after the indicated treatments. (F) Individual TC-1 tumor growth curves after the indicated treatments. (G) Intracellular cytokine staining of PBMC CD8+ T cells restimulated ex vivo with E7 peptide on day 29. (H) PBMC CD8+ T cell memory analysis on day 29. Data: mean ± SEM. ∗p < 0.05; ∗∗p < 0.01; ∗∗∗p < 0.001. p value was determined by Student’s t test.
